subject: Matemática
description_pt: Descrever características de algumas figuras geométricas espaciais (prismas retos, pirâmides, cilindros, cones), relacionando-as com suas planificações.

components.description_pt: Descrever características de prismas e pirâmides retos, incluindo faces, arestas e vértices
components.description_en: Describe characteristics of right prisms and pyramids, including faces, edges, and vertices
components.cc_component_description: Analyze three-dimensional shapes in different sizes and orientations, using informal language to describe their parts, including number of sides and vertices/corners, as well as other attributes (e.g. having sides of equal length)

components.description_pt: Descrever características de cilindros e cones
components.description_en: Describe characteristics of cylinders and cones
components.cc_component_description: Identify the shape of a cross-section of a three-dimensional object, including prisms, pyramids, cylinders, cones, and spheres

components.description_pt: Relacionar uma figura geométrica tridimensional à sua planificação bidimensional
components.description_en: Relate a three-dimensional geometric figure to its two-dimensional net
components.cc_component_description: Use nets to find the surface area of three-dimensional figures

cc_matches.description: Identify the shapes of two-dimensional cross-sections of three-dimensional objects, and identify three-dimensional objects generated by rotations of two-dimensional objects.

Represent three-dimensional figures using nets made up of rectangles and triangles, and use the nets to find the surface area of these figures. Apply these techniques in the context of solving real-world and mathematical problems.

Analyze and compare two- and three-dimensional shapes, in different sizes and orientations, using informal language to describe their similarities, differences, parts (e.g., number of sides and vertices/"corners") and other attributes (e.g., having sides of equal length).
